text: This report responds to a request from the Parks and Environment Committee to consider the adaptive reuse of buildings M and T in Ashbridges Bay Park, and provides an update on the exploration of the potential adaptive reuse of the buildings by Parks, Forestry and Recreation, Toronto Water, City Planning, Internal Corporate Services, and Economic Development and Culture. Toronto Water, City Planning, Internal Corporate Services, and Economic Development and Culture have all been consulted and approve this report. Following a series of site visits, representatives from these divisions have concluded that there is potential for a community related re-development of the buildings. It is anticipated that Toronto Water will decommission buildings M and T in approximately 10 years, at which point reuse of the buildings could be implemented, subject to further review.
The Parks and Environment Committee received the report (April 12, 2018) from the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation for information.
